blurb: Victory EMS & Medical Transportation offers 24/7 EMS and medical transportation services across Boise, Idaho, and surrounding areas. They provide advanced life support, basic life support, critical care, long-distance EMS, standby event coverage, and medical flights. Their teams are trained professionals equipped to handle various medical transport needs with a focus on safety and continuous care.
